tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search active listings on Defici.com global marketplace. Returns paginated results. Contact details are not included — this is a read-only discovery tool. Prices are in USD: every listing price is stored in USD (converted at ingest from the seller's currency via daily FX rates), and price_min/price_

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single listing by its UUID. Returns the listing if active, sold, or expired. Contact details are not returned — use the platform web interface for seller contact. The price is in USD; currency_original and price_original (when present) show what the seller originally priced

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Return the complete category taxonomy for Defici.com. Use the category id values as the category argument in search_listings.

tools.name: get_regions
tools.description: Return all supported market regions with their id, country, currency, and languages. Use the region id as the market argument in search_listings.

tools.name: get_subscription_info
tools.description: Capability tiers available on Defici, described by what each tier unlocks — not by price (pricing is not finalized yet, so no price figure is returned by this tool). Covers two independent tiers an agent can hold at once: the AI API plan (listing/photo/rate caps) and, where enabled, the partner tier

tools.name: buy_plan
tools.description: Buy (or upgrade) your Defici agent plan with no human: method "spt" pays with a Stripe Shared Payment Token your wallet granted to Defici (EUR; for monthly auto-renewal use recurring_interval=month and max_amount >= 2 x price); method "approved_card" charges the card your operator approved once (POS

tools.name: billing_status
tools.description: Your current plan, credits, renewal date, scheduled plan change, monthly cap and what you spent this month.

tools.name: billing_history
tools.description: Your payments (newest first, up to 100): plan, kind (purchase/renewal), amount, status (paid / refunded_or_disputed).
